instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Crest is a boutique insurance brokerage specializing in complex risk management advisory services across property, casualty, cyber liability, and D&O coverage. Operating within a high-stakes regulatory landscape, the firm manages significant capital for corporate clients while navigating stringent compliance requirements.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring to improve client acquisition efficiency.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: We have two generalist developers who split their time between maintaining existing systems and handling support escalations. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role, meaning process improvements are opportunistic and resource-constrained.
answers.additionalContext: The firm faces intense pricing competition and rapid digital transformation demands from larger competitors in the brokerage space.

opportunities.title: Implement Automated Client Onboarding Workflow (Defensive)
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure and short time horizon, automating the client onboarding process will reduce operational friction and improve perceived service quality. This directly addresses churn drivers by making initial engagement faster and more seamless.

first_actions: Map current manual onboarding steps to identify automation points
Select a low-code/no-code solution for integration with existing CRM
Pilot the workflow with 5 key enterprise clients
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average client onboarding time by 25% within Q3.
milestones: Pilot launch and feedback cycle complete: Week 6
Full deployment across all new clients: Month 3

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Dynamic Pricing Engine for Cyber Risk Products (Market Defense)
opportunities.rationale: To defend against high-pressure market pricing, developing an AI model that dynamically adjusts premium quotes based on real-time cyber threat data could create a unique competitive advantage. This requires significant effort but offers the potential to redefine their service offering in niche risk areas.

first_actions: Conduct proof-of-concept feasibility study for AI model training
Identify and secure specialized data feeds related to cyber threat intelligence
Allocate specific R&D time (40% of developer capacity)
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Contractual support from an external AI consultant
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 10% reduction in premium volatility compared to market average.
milestones: Beta testing with internal underwriting team: Month 6
Soft launch/Market introduction of pricing feature: Q4

opportunities.title: Self-Service Claims Status Portal (Customer Retention)
opportunities.rationale: Addressing customer feedback directly by providing a self-service portal for tracking policy updates and claims status will significantly improve the digital experience. This is a necessary defensive move to retain mid-tier clients who cite poor digital tools.

first_actions: Define minimum viable product (MVP) features (tracking only)
Integrate tracking API with core policy management system
Design and build a secure, mobile-responsive interface
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase policyholder self-service interaction rate by 30% within 6 months.
milestones: Wireframe and UX design finalized: Month 2
MVP development complete and internal testing: Month 5
Public launch to enterprise clients: Month 7

next_steps.action: Conduct an immediate strategic workshop to finalize the roadmap prioritizing the 'Self-Service Portal' MVP.
Allocate dedicated internal time for one developer specifically focused on scoping and prototyping the AI Dynamic Pricing Engine feasibility study.
Establish a monthly review cadence to track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer retention and operational cost reduction.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on 'owner_alone' decision-making, leading to potential bottlenecks in complex strategic shifts.
Lack of dedicated innovation bandwidth and resource allocation, forcing opportunistic and often reactive improvements.
Limited digital maturity (Level 2) hindering the ability to offer competitive self-service tools that customers demand.
